text:
maya: FYI found a service account key leaked in partner-ingest logs, looks like it propagated to their infra. grabbing more context now.

oncall-bot: Alert: log-scraper found plaintext-looking key material in logs for project=redwood-ingest-prod (50 hits, 3h window).

lex: Ugh. scope? prod only or staging too?

maya: Hits in prod bucket access logs and a couple of archived debug dumps in staging. seems originating from an old webhook that logs request bodies.

samir: First tasks: (1) isolate the SA, (2) rotate/delete keys, (3) block partner ingress, (4) rewrap any Vault data that used that key, (5) run an audit for token reuse. I'll own rotation if no objections.

claudia: @samir go for it. I'll ping partner PM to ask them to pause ingest and give us a temporary IP block window. sending email now.

jordan: Quick containment commands if helpful:
```
gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=ingest-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY_ID --iam-account=ingest-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
# annotate k8s secrets to force reload in pods
kubectl annotate secret ingest-credentials cleared-at=$(date -u +%s) -n ingest || true
```

lex: Also add short RBAC deny for that SA to stop future use while we rotate: create a deny binding in org policy or remove roles from the SA. coordinate with infra-team to apply immediate deny.

samir: Plan for Vault/KMS:
- If the SA was used to unwrap KMS-wrapped backups, schedule a Vault transit rewrap using a different wrapping key.
- Revoke any Vault tokens issued to that SA and force reissuance.
- If backups were exported with wrapped ciphertext, re-encrypt after new wrap key.

maya: Confirmed the SA was used by an old backup job that used KMS key projects/redwood-kms/wrappingKeys/backup-wrap. We'll need to rewrap those archives.

claudia: Partner asked for a short maintenance window. proposing 15:30 UTC to disable webhook, 15:35 rotate keys, 15:45 rewrap job kickoff. Thoughts?

lex: Sounds good. Add fallback: if rewrap job fails, toggle to read-only mode and spin a new ingest queue in a separate project.

samir: I'll run rotations and post a checklist as I go. tagging oncall for help: @oncall-bot please create incident ticket and set priority P1 for creds-leak.

oncall-bot: Created incident INC-2026-3344 "partner webhook credential bleed" assigned to eng-security. Priority: P1.

jordan: Small validation snippet to find potential reuse in logs: 
```
grep -R "AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{35}" /var/log/ingest || true
# or search for service account json blobs
jq -r '.private_key' archived_debug_dumps/*.json | head -n 5
```

maya: Also a reminder: rotate service account any time a key may have been exported to third parties. The key lifecycle is compromised.

claudia: Who's owning partner comms? I can do the first message now and follow up with required actions.

maya: pls do. include that we asked them to pause ingest and we will share verification once rewrap completes.

samir: Checklists I'm executing now:
- [x] Remove SA keys (deleted two old keys)
- [x] Apply temporary deny on SA roles
- [ ] Rewrap backups with new wrap key (in progress)
- [ ] Revoke Vault tokens issued in last 90d for that SA
- [ ] Run search for exposures in archived logs and partner dumps
- [ ] Postmortem + audit timeline

lex: When rewrap finishes, ping infra to rotate KMS key (if needed) and schedule a quick eval of performance impact. we may need to tune rewrap batch size.

claudia: Partner confirmed pause and provided IPs to block. I've shared the maintenance window.

maya: thanks. once rewrap job produces a manifest, we'll share checksums so partner can verify.

samir: Rewrap started, 120 archives queued, doing 10/min to stay under throughput. will update progress here.

jordan: added a short guard to Vault to require mfa for re-issuing critical tokens for the next 48h. snippet: 
```
vault write auth/token/roles/temporary require_mfa=true
```

maya: Good call. Also we'll add audit logging hook to forward all unwrap/decrypt events to secure-analytics for 30 days.

oncall-bot: INC-2026-3344 updated: rewrap in progress, owner=samir, eta=~2h.

claudia: Nice. postmortem owners? propose maya+samir with infra support from lex.

maya: fine by me. I'll start timeline notes and evidence collection.

samir: Rewrap finished, 120/120. Running verification now.

jordan: Verified manifests match expected checksums and partner acked. starting revocation cascade for leftover creds.

maya: Closing containment now. open follow-ups: 1) tighten logging to avoid body dump, 2) create a pre-commit lint to prevent accidental inclusion of keys in dumps, 3) schedule rotation drill next quarter.

claudia: I'll file the follow-up tickets and assign. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
